newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee flat on lack of imports.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee flat on lack of imports.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee was steady in early Friday trading due to a lack of commercial demand, dealers said.
At 0500 GMT the rupee was at its opening level of 58.55 to the dollar, they said.
"Since there are no imports to cover, the exchange rate is going to be around current levels," said a dealer at Hongkong and Shanghai Bank.
"Speculators are staying away despite low call money rates because of the Central Bank action, which was not positive towards the dollar," he added.
The Central Bank pushed down the dollar by one local cent, fixing buying and selling prices at 58.3506 and 59.5294.
Overnight call money was at 11 percent after opening at 10, dealers said.
